hypotheses.claim: Positive cumulative XRP ETF net flows may provide structural demand support.
hypotheses.support: Cumulative net inflows remain positive in secondary trackers.

hypotheses.claim: Long-skewed futures positioning can amplify downside if spot liquidity thins.
hypotheses.support: TradRadar reports 78.1% long accounts and positive funding; Liqwall reports 71.7% Binance long accounts.
hypotheses.disconfirming: Account ratios are not notional positioning; OI totals differ materially; no causal price-impact study was performed.

hypotheses.claim: High reported OI indicates leverage is an important XRP market-structure variable.
hypotheses.support: All providers report substantial XRP derivatives OI.
hypotheses.disconfirming: Provider scope and timestamps are inconsistent; aggregate totals are not comparable yet.

hypotheses.disconfirming: No matched corridor-level net settlement or XRP bridge-volume comparison is available.
